portraits.name: 高澄
portraits.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: an original painted character portrait for the historical strategy RPG Fengyun Nanbeichao, matching the approved existing portrait series.
Input roles: Image 1 is the user's reference for THIS subject's facial character, costume colors, pose and distinctive details. Image 2 is ONLY the approved GAME STYLE reference: match its fine irregular ink contours, restrained transparent watercolor shading, convincing but flat illustrated anatomy, pale ivory paper, detailed cloth folds and quiet natural light. Do not copy Image 2's person, beard, hairstyle, clothes or age.
Create one ORIGINAL cohesive illustration, not a collage, screenshot, map or traced reproduction. Canvas portrait 1024x1536, exact 2:3. Single centered waist-to-upper-thigh half-length standing figure. Entire headwear and shoulders within canvas, clear readable face near upper third, generous face detail for square avatar cropping, minimal negative space. Both hands and any prop anatomically coherent and fully inside the image. Clean uniform pale ivory paper background with extremely subtle fine paper grain, no landscape, frame, labels, map, rivers, text, seal, watermark or logo. No gritty sepia overlay, photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, fantasy armor, modern hair or theatrical facial makeup. All costume and appearance are restrained artistic interpretation of sixth-century China, not a claim of authenticated historical likeness.
Subject: Gao Cheng (高澄), around 25 years old in the game's 546 opening, Eastern Wei high aristocrat and powerful young court minister, NOT an emperor. Preserve Image 1's elegant tall slim proportions, handsome long face, sculpted high cheekbones, broad well-shaped dark eyebrows, bright narrow eyes, straight nose, black swept-up hair and small upright warm reddish-brown three-ridge court cap. Clean shaven. Youthful confident composure and a faint controlled smile, body slightly three-quarter, gaze toward viewer; polished and assured without a sneer. Keep the ochre-gold broad-sleeved robe, rust-red patterned lapel and lower garment, ivory inner draped collar, dark layered waist belt, modest jade pendant, and sheathed ring-pommel sword at left waist. Colors are muted mineral pigment ochre and cinnabar, not bright synthetic yellow. Adapt the reference's expansive open-palmed gesture to a compact half-length composition: elbows bent and lowered, one open hand at waist level and the other partly gathered in sleeve; no huge outstretched arm span. No imperial mian crown, pearl curtains, emperor dragon robe, imperial throne or facial hair.
